title.en: AN ACT TRANSFERRING THE ADMINISTRATION OF MINING GRANTS AND CLAIMS INSTITUTED PRIOR TO APRIL ELEVENTH, EIGHTEEN HUNDRED AND NINETY-NINE, FROM THE MINING BUREAU TO THE BUREAU OF PUBLIC LANDS.
title.orig: AN ACT TRANSFERRING THE ADMINISTRATION OF MINING GRANTS AND CLAIMS INSTITUTED PRIOR TO APRIL ELEVENTH, EIGHTEEN HUNDRED AND NINETY-NINE, FROM THE MINING BUREAU TO THE BUREAU OF PUBLIC LANDS.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển việc quản lý các giấy phép khai thác mỏ và đơn xin khai thác mỏ được nộp trước ngày 11 tháng Tư năm 1899 từ Cục Khai thác Mỏ sang Cục Đất Công
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติโอนการบริหารใบอนุญาตกิจการเหมืองแร่และคำร้องขอสิทธิการทำเหมืองแร่ที่จัดตั้งขึ้นก่อนวันที่ ๑๑ เมษายน พ.ศ. ๒๔๔๒ จากสำนักเหมืองแร่ไปยังสำนักที่ดินสาธารณะ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalihkan administrasi izin pertambangan dan klaim pertambangan yang didirikan sebelum 11 April 1899 dari Biro Pertambangan ke Biro Tanah Publik
title.ms: Akta yang memindahkan pentadbiran lesen perlombongan dan tuntutan perlombongan yang ditubuhkan sebelum 11 April 1899 daripada Jabatan Perlombongan kepada Jabatan Tanah Awam

text.en:
The records and archives of all existing mining claims of whatever class or description now in the
custody and under the charge and. official control of the Mining Bureau and pertaining to the so-called
Spanish mining grants and mining claims of every kind instituted prior to April eleventh, eighteen hundred
and ninety-nine, shall be, as quickly as practicable, inventoried and turned over to the Bureau of Public
Lands and receipted for by the Chief of that Bureau.

The administration of such Spanish mining grants and mining claims of every kind instituted prior
to April eleventh, eighteen hundred and ninety-nine, and heretofore vested in, and exercised by, the Mining
Bureau, is hereby transferred to and shall hereafter be vested in, and exercised by, the Bureau of Public

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 1, 1903.
